completion_mismatch.clears: the evidence the completion lacked being observed and reverified

completion_unverified.clears: a later reading that establishes the check either way

delivery_refused.clears: the delivery being sent or settling, or its newest withholding naming another reason

delivery_stalled.clears: a delivery to the same recipient reaching dispatched

managed_start_failed.clears: the request recording an accepted receipt or attaching, or its newest creation-stage answer saying something else

observation_stalled.clears: a successful poll of the same anchor, or its turn settling

observation_unmeasured.clears: a later reading of the same turn that establishes something

product_defect.clears: a later reading of the same product, component and symptom that finds it gone, or the fix and reverification loop

product_expected.clears: the expected state ending: the cancellation settled, the approval given, or the support added

project_needed.clears: the project being created and bound; the record stays as that project's creation record

record_sync_failed.clears: any synchronisation job on the same target confirming

report_omitted.clears: a reading of the same turn that no longer says unreported

unclassified_incident.clears: classification into a registered product, which re-files every stored incident there
